arguments.sql: SELECT SUM(t.amount_usd_cents) / 100.0 AS total_amount_usd, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id WHERE ml.state = 'NY'
arguments.explanation: Adds up all transaction amounts, shown in dollars, at merchant locations in New York state. It also returns how many transactions that total covers.
assumptions: Negative amounts are included in the total as they are, because what they mean is not documented.
All transactions are included, whether or not they have a fraud label or an error, across the full data range of 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
